Tracking data provides real-time corrections to these models, enabling dynamic adjustments in both GSI’s Bayesian inference and GSE’s situational reasoning. The system fails under high wind or precipitation, or when Kalshi and book lines diverge beyond 3 points, indicating stale market priors. Dualities emerge between macro (weather) and micro (player tracking) scales, with each layer informing the next. Failure modes include assumption violations in air modeling, incorrect injury status reporting, and outdated tracking algorithms.
